verses.en: For the Leader; on the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David.

verses.he: הֹושִׁ֣יעָה יְ֭הוָה כִּי־גָמַ֣ר חָסִ֑יד כִּי־פַ֥סּוּ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.ar: خَلِّصْ يَارَبُّ، لِأَنَّهُ قَدِ ٱنْقَرَضَ ٱلتَّقِيُّ، لِأَنَّهُ قَدِ ٱنْقَطَعَ ٱلْأُمَنَاءُ مِنْ بَنِي ٱلْبَشَرِ.
verses.en: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.kjv: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.web: Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

verses.he: שָׁ֤וְא ׀ יְֽדַבְּרוּ֮ אִ֤ישׁ אֶת־רֵ֫עֵ֥הוּ שְׂפַ֥ת חֲלָקֹ֑ות בְּלֵ֖ב וָלֵ֣ב יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.ar: يَتَكَلَّمُونَ بِٱلْكَذِبِ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مَعَ صَاحِبِهِ، بِشِفَاهٍ مَلِقَةٍ، بِقَلْبٍ فَقَلْبٍ يَتَكَلَّمُونَ.
verses.en: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbour; with flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak.
verses.kjv: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: [with] flattering lips [and] with a double heart do they speak.
verses.web: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

verses.he: יַכְרֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל־שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲלָקֹ֑ות לָ֝שֹׁ֗ון מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת גְּדֹלֹֽות׃
verses.ar: يَقْطَعُ ٱلرَّبُّ جَمِيعَ ٱلشِّفَاهِ ٱلْمَلِقَةِ وَٱللِّسَانَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّمَ بِٱلْعَظَائِمِ،
verses.en: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that speaketh proud things!
verses.kjv: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, [and] the tongue that speaketh proud things:
verses.web: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽמְר֨וּ ׀ לִלְשֹׁנֵ֣נוּ נַ֭גְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵ֣ינוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ מִ֖י אָדֹ֣ון לָֽנוּ׃
verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا: «بِأَلْسِنَتِنَا نَتَجَبَّرُ. شِفَاهُنَا مَعَنَا. مَنْ هُوَ سَيِّدٌ عَلَيْنَا؟».
verses.en: Who have said: 'Our tongue will we make mighty; our lips are with us: who is lord over us?'
verses.kjv: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips [are] our own: who [is] lord over us?
verses.web: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

verses.he: מִשֹּׁ֥ד עֲנִיִּים֮ מֵאַנְקַ֪ת אֶבְיֹ֫ונִ֥ים עַתָּ֣ה אָ֭קוּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ית בְּ֝יֵ֗שַׁע יָפִ֥יחַֽ לֹֽו׃
verses.ar: «مِنِ ٱغْتِصَابِ ٱلْمَسَاكِينِ، مِنْ صَرْخَةِ ٱلْبَائِسِينَ، ٱلْآنَ أَقُومُ، يَقُولُ ٱلرَّبُّ، أَجْعَلُ فِي وُسْعٍ ٱلَّذِي يُنْفَثُ فِيهِ».
verses.en: 'For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise', saith the LORD; 'I will set him in safety at whom they puff.'
verses.kjv: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set [him] in safety [from him that] puffeth at him.
verses.web: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

verses.he: אִֽמֲרֹ֣ות יְהוָה֮ אֲמָרֹ֪ות טְהֹ֫רֹ֥ות כֶּ֣סֶף צָ֭רוּף בַּעֲלִ֣יל לָאָ֑רֶץ מְ֝זֻקָּ֗ק שִׁבְעָתָֽיִם׃
verses.ar: كَلَامُ ٱلرَّبِّ كَلَامٌ نَقِيٌّ، كَفِضَّةٍ مُصَفَّاةٍ فِي بُوطَةٍ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ، مَمْحُوصَةٍ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ.
verses.en: The words of the LORD are pure words, as silver tried in a crucible on the earth, refined seven times.
verses.kjv: The words of the LORD [are] pure words: [as] silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
verses.web: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

verses.he: אַתָּֽה־יְהוָ֥ה תִּשְׁמְרֵ֑ם תִּצְּרֶ֓נּוּ ׀ מִן־הַדֹּ֖ור ז֣וּ לְעֹולָֽם׃
verses.ar: أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ تَحْفَظُهُمْ. تَحْرُسُهُمْ مِنْ هَذَا ٱلْجِيلِ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ.
verses.en: Thou wilt keep them, O LORD; Thou wilt preserve us from this generation for ever.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
verses.web: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

verses.he: סָבִ֗יב רְשָׁעִ֥ים יִתְהַלָּכ֑וּן כְּרֻ֥ם זֻ֝לּ֗וּת לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.ar: ٱلْأَشْرَارُ يَتَمَشَّوْنَ مِنْ كُلِّ نَاحِيَةٍ عِنْدَ ٱرْتِفَاعِ ٱلْأَرْذَالِ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ.
verses.en: The wicked walk on every side, when vileness is exalted among the sons of men.
verses.kjv: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
verses.web: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
